items.title: Anthropic's Disproof of the ETH
items.author: bananaflag https://news.ycombinator.com/user?id=bananaflag
items.summary: We refute the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH) by presenting a deterministic algorithm for 3-SAT on n variables that runs in $2^{o(n)}$ time. Our algorithm in fact solves the harder problem #3-SAT, providing a count of the number of satisfying assignments. The result was discovered by an internal research Claude model and has been formalized in Lean 4.
